stories.title: South Korea education minister resigns over exam cheating scandal
stories.summary: Choi Kyo-jin admits last-minute measures to stop AI-assisted cheating during the college entrance exam caused chaos.
stories.detail: Choi Kyo-jin said he ‘failed to prepare adequately’ for entrance exams, which this year had phones banned and checks for cameras hidden in clothing South Korea’s education minister resigned on Sunday after an AI-assisted cheating scandal that erupted in the lead-up to the country’s key university entrance exams. The country has been gripped by fears of AI-assisted exam cheating since last Sunday, when the top scorer in a national tax accountant exam confessed to using a miniature camera and smartphone to achieve a near-perfect score, just four days before the crucial university entrance exam known as the suneung.

details.summary: Choi Kyo-jin admits last-minute measures to stop AI-assisted cheating during the college entrance exam caused chaos.

stories.title: Trump orders federal contractors to check with White House before responding to Congress
stories.summary: President Trump is directing federal contractors to consult the White House about inquiries from Congress and to withhold any communications that his administration considers privileged.
stories.detail: Anticipating flood of Democratic requests, US president issues executive order in attempt to stymie oversight efforts Donald Trump is directing federal contractors and subcontractors to consult with his administration about inquiries they receive from Congress and to withhold any communications that the White House considers privileged, according to an executive order issued late Friday. The companies must also coordinate with the White House and US agencies on “appropriate responses” to any such requests, the order says. If they fail to comply, the White House warns, their contracts could be terminated and their future work with the federal government suspended.

details.summary: President Trump is directing federal contractors to consult the White House about inquiries from Congress and to withhold any communications that his administration considers privileged.

stories.title: Navdeep Bains eked out the Liberal leadership. Winning Ontario will be even harder
stories.summary: A former federal minister with no seat at Queen's Park and few policy details must unite a party that trails Doug Ford's Tories in the polls.

details.summary: A former federal minister with no seat at Queen's Park and few policy details must unite a party that trails Doug Ford's Tories in the polls.

stories.summary: The Department of War is “taking steps to ensure its engagements with Canada advance tangible U.S. defense objectives, the Chief Pentagon spokesperson told Global News.

stories.title: Russian strike kills two, wounds 60, in Zelenskyy’s hometown
stories.summary: Attack on Kryvyi Rih comes as Russian missiles land in NATO member Poland and US-led peace efforts face uncertainty.
stories.detail: A Russian strike on the centre of Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's hometown, Kryvyi Rih, killed two people and wounded 60 others, local officials said Saturday.
